title: Paint Blast
short_description: Drag to paint — fill 80% of the canvas to win
long_description:
Paint Blast is a self-contained single-page HTML5 game from the Omega Games library. Click and drag to paint. Fill 80% of the canvas to win!

Controls: tap/click or drag. No installation, no account, no external network calls — the whole game is one HTML file that runs entirely in the browser tab it's loaded in.

It's a short-session arcade title built for quick, replayable rounds.

Built for embedding: the page has no iframe-blocking headers, so it drops straight into a portal frame at any size. Session length is short (seconds to a few minutes per round), which fits browsing/portal traffic patterns rather than a long-form download.

Source id: paint_blast. Part of a 21-title batch of small HTML5 games being submitted from the same library — if you like this one, the others share the same lightweight, dependency-free build.
cover_capture_method: playwright chromium headless, local file:// build
